metadata.name: Elm Grove
metadata.author: ChronoSplit
metadata.description: A cul-de-sac of five homes off a main street at sunset. Embers hold the turnaround at the end of the grove, Tide come off the main street past the corner shop and the gas station. Two-storey houses with gardens either side of the road, side yards to slip between them, and the road itself for the brave.
